identities.internal: validation-identity-binding.v1 retains original; native id hashes full coordinate, revision is exact contentId

gaps.immutable: gap.v1 revision=1 is format revision; contentId hashes full immutable gap
gaps.projection: work-cell-gap.v1 contentId pins original; gap-binding.v1 retains full original
gaps.workflow: work-cell-command.v1 expectedRevision and candidate-admission.v1 workflowRevision are CAS integers; contribution.gapRevision is immutable contentId

routes.candidates: POST candidate-admission.v1; only installed recipe identity; unsupported returns HTTP 422 unsupported.v1, no partial acceptance
routes.environmentEvidence: POST environment-evidence-submission.v1 -> environment-evidence-observation.v1; GET lists project evidence; no graph promotion

ownership.VF05: participation only; existing authenticated work-cell ports
ownership.VF06: composition proposal only; exact dependencies; installed evaluator decides support
ownership.VF07: allocation advisory only; no reservation, verifier or budget authority

storage: PostgreSQL jsonb: valid wire strings containing lone surrogates or NUL return explicit unsupported; no Unicode replacement/normalization
authority: VF02/VF04 reserve work; VF03/VF04 assign verifiers and budget; wire data grants no authority
